name: Target: Dalson's Tears
label: Quest
description: Target: Dalson's Tears: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. Well, we shall shed no tears this day as we thwart the Scourge and have them choke on their own fumes!

Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you into the cauldron. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.

clips.title: Progress
paras: An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. In order to open it, you will need to find the key.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The macabre key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.
There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.
